    public static final int ZONE_COUNT = RATES.length;

    private ShippingRateTable() {
        // static lookups only
    }

    public static int feeFor(final int zone, final int weightGrams) {
        final int band = bandFor(weightGrams);
        return rateFor(zone, band);
    }

    public static int bandFor(final int weightGrams) {
        final int band = weightGrams / BAND_WIDTH_GRAMS;
        return Math.min(band, BAND_COUNT - 1);
    }

    public static int rateFor(final int zone, final int band) {
        return zoneRates(zone)[band];
    }

    public static boolean isPremiumZone(final int zone) {
        return zone >= PREMIUM_ZONE_FLOOR;
    }

    private static int[] zoneRates(final int zone) {
        return RATES[zone];
    }

    private static int[] row(final int... cents) {
        return cents;
    }
}
